study.title: Whole Blood Measurements from the SpaceX Inspiration4 Mission (RNA-seq, epitranscriptome, WGS, clonal hematopoiesis, CBC)
study.attribution: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), OSD-569, DOI 10.26030/e0rx-sh52, CC0 1.0.

transformation.derivedLookupKeyRule: derivedLookupKey = participantToken + '::' + timepointLabel; runtime key only, never a replacement for sampleId.
transformation.missingValuePolicy: Empty cells, 'NA' and 'N/A' are explicit missing tokens. A missing value is null and is never coerced to zero.
transformation.unitPolicy: Units come only from the column-header suffix and are stored verbatim as tokens; headers without a unit stay null.
transformation.referenceRangePolicy: range_min/range_max (and the ALT/AST '*_max_*' alias) are copied per sample. They are laboratory reference intervals, not clinical decision thresholds.
transformation.percentFieldPolicy: Vendor '*_percent' and '*_percent_normalized_value' fields are preserved as opaque source-derived values with no unit and no documented formula.
